    Image-closed subcategories as intersections (Theorem A) #

    Section 4.1 of the manuscript. For an image-closed subcategory Z, Construction 4.3 defines

    • T⁺(Z): the objects X such that every morphism X → N with N ∈ Z has image in Z (upperFirst);
    • F⁻(Z) = {Y : t_{T⁺(Z)}(Y) ∈ Z} (lowerSecond).

    Theorem 4.4 (Theorem A): for a subcategory Z the following are equivalent: Z is image-closed; Z = Gen Z ∩ Cogen Z; Z = T ∩ F for a pretorsion theory (T, F). The pair (T⁺(Z), F⁻(Z)) realizes an image-closed Z, and by Corollary 4.5 it is the greatest realization.
